## The shape

What the component (or token, or utility class) is, in one paragraph. If it
exists somewhere as local UI, link the code.

## Where it is needed

At least two places, in one or more projects, where the same shape appears
today. The package grows only with shapes that repeat (`AGENTS.md` §3).

## What stays in the app

The content, the data source, the layout around it: what the package must
NOT know.

## Props and states

A first draft of the props and of the states to show in the showcase.
